tells.1: Mild stock encouragement: “get a nudge” and “see how far you've come.”
tells.2: Generic promotional promises: “Never miss a session again” and “watch your progress grow!”
tells.3: Conspicuously casual phrasing—“bouncing back,” “give you a nudge,” “tweak your plan”—makes the warmth feel manufactured.
tells.4: Polished but empty assurances: “guidance you can trust,” “BUILT FOR REAL RECOVERY,” and “unlock more of what the app has to offer.”
tells.5: Repeated explanatory constructions make the copy slightly mechanical, particularly the feature bullets.

reason: Version 1 best balances clear features, credible language, and an approachable App Store voice; version 5 is restrained but less fluid. These are stylistic judgments, not reliable evidence of AI authorship.
